title: Splendors of Vietnam with FREE Mekong Delta Tour
overview:
About the Activity: 
Take a fun and exciting cycling trip from Ha Noi to Pleiku in Vietnam to explore the eastern part of this beautiful country.
Meander through scenic roads, sometimes through the countyside and sometimes through the coast for a truly remarkable time.
Start cycling from Ha Noi and along the way of your tour, visit Ninh Binh, Vinh, Dong Loc, Huong Khe, Dong Hoi, Khe Sanh, A luoi, A Sau, Phuoc Son and Kon Tum.
The Ho Chi Minh trail was a path that ran from the Democratic Republic
of Vietnam (North Vietnam) to the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam) through
the neighboring kingdoms of Laos and Cambodia The trail was not a single route, but rather a complex maze of truck routes, paths for foot and bicycle traffic, and river transportation systems.  You will get to explore the beautiful pathway as you ride through it.
Visit the Dinh and Le temples and travel to Tam Coc, a strikingly beautiful region of limestone-cliffs and
rice paddies.

Take a boat ride to visit the Phong Nha caves and explore this beautiful cave system.
Visit the historical Truong Son National Cemetery where thousands of Vietnamese soldiers died for their country during the Vietnam war.
The tour ends at Kontum village from where you can transfer to Pleiku, Ho Chi Minh or Hanoi for your return flight 
This trip is for 10 days and 9 nights.

know_before_you_go: All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Meals in the restaurants or cafes are nor included.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Travel insurance is not included in the package.
Kindly note that personal expenses are not included in the package and should be budgeted separately.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. After checking in, take some time to relax and unwind from your journey. You have the rest of the day at leisure to explore the bustling streets of Hanoi, savour local delicacies, or simply rest at your hotel.

days.title: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Check-out and get transferred for Halong Bay Overnight cruise. Board the cruise from Tuan Chao Harbour. Explore Titop Island, Pearl Farm Village, and Duck Islet. Enjoy water activities like kayaking in the Halong Bay. Later, learn cooking some local Vietnamese dishes. Afterwards, have an overnight stay on the cruise

Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the scenery while sipping the welcome drink. Reach Tiptop Island and relax. 
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. Return to the cruise. Afterwards, join the cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food. 
Enjoy the overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer from Halong Bay to Ho Chi Minh via Hanoi
days.desc: Wake up early to witness the mesmerizing sunrise from your deck and enhance your journey with Chinese martial arts and Tai Chi sessions on board. Later, explore Halong Bay's largest caves, the Surprise Caves. Afterward, return to the cruise to complete your check-out formalities before heading back to Halong Bay Harbor. From there, you will be transferred to Hanoi Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh. Check-in at your hotel in Ho Chi Minh for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise
items.desc:
Begin your day by practicing Tai Chi, the Chinese martial art, on the Sundeck. 
Next, explore the seven new wonders of the world in Halong Bay.
Next, take a small passenger boat to reach Surprise Cave (Sung Sot), Halong Bay's largest cave spanning 12,000 square meters and admire its natural scenery.
Get back on the cruise and head to Tuan Chau Harbor.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour | Visit the Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: Start your day by immersing yourself in the iconic attractions of Ho Chi Minh City, including the Independence Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, and War Remnants Museum. Then, venture to the Cu Chi Tunnels, a historic landmark of Vietnam. Conclude your day with a transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

days.title: Mekong Delta Tour
days.desc: Begin your day by getting transferred to My Tho city, where you will discover the beauty of the Mekong Delta. Upon reaching there, visit the Vinh Trang Pagoda and later, get on a boat ride to watch fishermen on floating houses. Continue the boat ride to visit An Khanh and more. Enjoy some time at leisure before getting transferred to the hotel in Ho Chi Minh, for an overnight stay.
